messages:
Priya (CS): quick weekly check-in on account X — noticed a model-mix shift after the v2-lite rollout yesterday. TL;DR: new model adoption ~34%, overall usage +8% WoW, fallbacks spiked. attaching quick numbers below.

Dan (Infra Eng): dug into logs. fallback_rate = fallbacks / total_requests. seeing a spike from 0.6% -> 3.8% (peak window 11:20–11:35 PST). cache misses correlate with higher fallbacks.

Lena (Solutions): client noted a few degraded responses in the UI — they flagged ~6 conversations. Miguel, can we share sample prompts?

Miguel (PM): yes, uploaded 3 samples to the workspace: https://redwood.internal/accX/samples/181845. flagged length ~1.6x average.

Priya (CS): quick metrics snapshot: 
- total reqs: 24,200 (24h)
- new model (v2-lite) share: 34%
- fallback count: 920 -> rate 3.8% (baseline 0.6%)
- 95th latency: v2-lite 680ms vs baseline 420ms
- estimated cost delta: +19% per 1k tokens when routed to v2-lite

Dan (Infra Eng): possible causes: kernel selection fallback on long contexts + cold KV cache for prefix caching. Also saw a transient GPU OOM on a single host at 11:23 (auto-recovered). ops-bot posted the deploy: 
```
[ops-bot] 11:14 deploy v2-lite canary -> 10% -> 50% rollout
[ops-bot] 11:22 autoscale triggered +2 nodes
[ops-bot] 11:23 node-7 OOM -> evicted pods -> fallback to compatibility model
```

Lena (Solutions): so fallbacks mostly during the 11:20–11:30 window. Are fallbacks user-visible as errors or silent fallback to older model?

Dan (Infra Eng): silent fallback to v1-compat for streaming responses — UI shows small stutter but not full error. However quality delta may be visible.

Priya (CS): customer risk: medium. Usage increased, but higher latency & fallbacks could hit SLAs if sustained. Proposed actions: 
1) Pause v2-lite rollout to 25% until we patch KV cold start behavior.
2) Run targeted replay of the 3 sample prompts with extended context to repro and measure.
3) Offer customer proactive note + optional knob to pin to baseline for next 48h.

Miguel (PM): I can coordinate the rollback/pinning toggle and customer note. Suggest we also schedule an enablement call for tomorrow 10am PST to walk through changes and capture feedback.

Lena (Solutions): I'll run the prompt replay and push traces to the ticket (ACCX-412). Expect initial repro by EOD.

Dan (Infra Eng): I'll add a quick hotfix to keep KV warm on new model variants and add guardrails on autoscale to avoid churning on single OOMs.

Priya (CS): great — owner matrix: Miguel (customer comms & pin), Lena (replay + traces), Dan (hotfix + rollback if needed). Can everyone react with :thumbsup: when acknowledged?

ops-bot: incident note created ACCX-412, latency spike window 11:18–11:36, linked to deploy v2-lite canary.

Dan (Infra Eng): :thumbsup:
Lena (Solutions): :thumbsup:
Miguel (PM): :thumbsup:
Priya (CS): thanks team — will update customer after we verify replay results. schedule invite sent for 10am PST tomorrow.
